risk_flags.description: The promised test may not prove that year filtering works, because it uses data where the selected year already contains every sample row. If the implementation ignored `--year`, this specific test could still pass.

The contract leaves combined `--year` and `--month` behavior undefined. Since this is a CLI option added to an existing report command, the requester should confirm whether the flags should be mutually exclusive or composable.
risk_flags.span: No defined behavior when both `--year` and `--month` are passed simultaneously

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the proposed test does not actually validate year filtering because the sample data all falls in 2024.
